qualification.scope_note: Source/package qualification only; it is not installed functional acceptance.

normal_package_copy.scope: Exact bound download and immutable release install through the existing source-pinned installer; no DB/config/service/pointer activation.

closed_findings: All five prior pointers must be symlinks into the owned releases namespace and resolve to exact source 482.
Effective web/platform/admin ExecStart and WorkingDirectory paths are verified against the switched pointer set.
Canonical web/admin URLs and canonical-auth flags plus issuer are checked before mutation.
The planned migration must be exactly entitlements.0001_initial; the post-migration ledger delta must be exactly that one row with all prior rows unchanged.
Runtime UPDATE, DELETE, and TRUNCATE are checked denied on accessgrant, accessadjustment, and accesspreview.
Failure recovery restores only pointer/config values proven to be either pre-state or this procedure's own written values; unknown drift is preserved for readback.
declared_mutations: Apply the single additive entitlements migration using the own migration role.
Set only ALISA_ENTITLEMENTS_ENABLED=1 in platform configuration.
Switch only web-current, site-current, and admin-current to the exact c866 release.
Restart only platform, web, and admin stage services.
preserved_scope: Identity and shared current remain at source 482.
No identity canonicalization, callback migration, OWNER handover, or staff authority mutation.
No real customer grant, payment, or real-mail batch.

rollout_document.notes: Binds c866/482, canonical origins, normal-copy install, exact migration/ACL checks, rollback boundaries, resource reserve, and READY_FOR_OWNER_TEST limit.

required_after_activation: Report only READY_FOR_OWNER_TEST until the real OWNER performs the functional grant test.
Do not create or restore a test OWNER, execute identity handover, or expand acceptance to other bundled source features.

review_method: Read-only source, package, script, and rollout-document inspection; no tests or host actions were run.
